method.playbooks: git ls-tree -r --name-only MAIN_SHA docs/troubleshooting/playbooks; .md files excluding every index.md, sorted by path
method.references: Inline shot calls and Markdown image paths outside fences, comments and inline code; fence closers must be bare, same character and at least opener length. Source lines remain one-based.
method.layers: Portal Evidence Layer/Step subsections where present; Windows Kudu's three Portal views; otherwise section 6 Hn subsections, or the section 6 decision matrix. These are documentary units, not an exhaustive model of all runtime layers.
method.pinning: All playbook text, registry YAML and image bytes read with git show MAIN_SHA:path. Hashes match census files entries; current registry owns alt/provenance metadata, not the older census alts.
method.precedent: #405 retained an artifact, not its one-off generator or tests. This inventory likewise commits no generator; exact derivation and mutation commands are retained in the author evidence file.

classification.present: Documented navigation/observations/decisions exist at the declared limited scope; NOT a complete or correct trail certification
classification.missing: No embedded capture or missing per-image navigation/caption/decision trail; rationale distinguishes these
classification.stale: Reserved for an established UI/recipe mismatch; age alone or missing captions never establishes it
classification.blocked-manual: Capture access axis: authorized resources and compliant human sign-in are not available in this offline task

method.uncertainty: Freshness and unrecorded live captured_at remain Unknown; manifest conversion/repository-introduction dates are not live capture times. trail_complete is always false because semantic and pixel review were not performed.

field_contract.screenshots: Occurrence records, not independent observations. census_ref points to reused per-asset facts; canonical_alt_source names a registry ID, not a Markdown anchor.
field_contract.diagnostic_layers: Each unit carries a source line, navigation pointer (null when missing), direct observation support, decision pointer and missing signal. #L pointers address the source blob at main_sha, not rendered page anchors.
field_contract.classification_axes: classification describes documentary presence; capture_access separately describes manual prerequisites; freshness never inferred from either

capture_prerequisites.authorization: Resource/cost owner approves one controlled app, diagnostic question, fault/logging writes, region, SKU, runtime and cleanup boundary before execution; actual RBAC must permit the selected blades and SCM actions, not inferred from Reader access.
capture_prerequisites.human_session: Device-compliant interactively signed-in Chrome; human completes MFA and confirms English/en-US, Light not Auto, Flyout closed, service menu collapsed, notifications off and DevTools closed. No enrollment or cookie bypass.
capture_prerequisites.runner: scripts/capture/capture.cjs with portal-desktop-v1: 1600x1000 DPR1 viewport, zoom100%, UTC, light, reduced motion, stable blade-specific ready selector; 1440x900 final WebP. Raw PNG stays private. No capture is attempted here.
capture_prerequisites.privacy_and_review: Use imported text-replacement helper in frames and attributes; canvas/unsanitizable output fails or becomes sanitized text. Pin final-byte hash and honest provenance, short canonical alt and Purpose/Look for/Expected/Next step. Visually inspect final WebP for PII/caption accuracy; Oracle and exact-head CI before merge.
capture_prerequisites.owner: Maintainer selects child scope; resource owner authorizes; compliant-device human operator supplies session; reviewers judge final bytes.
